message.content: On April 10th, 2026, WolfgangSchulz expressed interest in the app that he had heard about, mentioning that he hadn't tried it yet but thought it might help him improve his drumming. He also suggested experimenting with it during their upcoming jam session, which was scheduled for Sunday. LiHua and YurikoYamamoto were supportive of this idea, agreeing to give it a try during their jam session. However, no specific new song was decided upon for this jam session based on the information provided. Instead, they discussed their plans to use a classic song like "Stand By Me" during their jam session.
